description: Auth bypass occurs when attacker can access protected resource without proper authentication.

testing: Try to access protected endpoint without auth — should be 401
Try with low-privilege token to access admin — should be 403
Check for JWT none algorithm, weak secret, etc.
methodology.evidence: Request without auth returns 200 with protected data, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce without auth, confirm protected data returned

remediation: Proper authentication, authorization, MFA, secure session management
